original_source: IGRAC GGMN; Thai Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment
package_license_notice: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per Zenodo package and Readme
reference_point: depth below ground surface, positive downward
head_anomaly_definition: negative depth plus per-well mean observed depth; full observed period, not GRACE baseline
aggregation: GROW annual YS and monthly MS aggregates; not original daily measurements
warning: Groundwater head fluctuations are not storage changes without aquifer storage coefficients; correlation does not prove human attribution
quality_control: Provider flags retained; compare sensitivity including/excluding flagged outliers/change points and plateaus.
